summary: Applies a gradient background, adds a blur effect, and animates a glowing background. The login page also includes a radial gradient effect with floating lights.
evidence: .loginPage::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -50%; left: -50%; width: 200%; height: 200%; background: radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(255, 0, 255, 0.08), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(circle at bottom left, rgba(0, 255, 255, 0.1), transparent 70%); animation: floatLights 20s linear infinite; z-index: 0; }
@keyframes floatLights { 0% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg); } 50% { transform: translate(50px, -30px) rotate(180deg); } 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(360deg); } }
